meta.website_logo_method: Websites from OpenStreetMap website tags matched by name within ~250 m of the SLA coordinate (Nominatim). Logos fetched from each site: img tagged logo, then apple-touch-icon, then og:image, then favicon; icons under 32 px dropped. Logo files are the businesses' own marks, used for identification.
